title: The snowbound orchard
alt: A snowbound orchard and warm timber barn beneath a lavender sky.
description: A softly painted winter landscape with intricate branches and a winding trail of footprints.
prompt: A poetic wide oil painting of an orchard in fresh snow, dark twisting apple-tree branches holding a few small red apples, a weathered timber barn with a warmly lit window, winding footprints along a narrow path, distant misty hills and a pale lavender winter sky. Rich painterly surface, intricate branches, subtle warm-cool contrast, quiet cinematic composition, no people or lettering.
